flags.text: Doc says hasInsufficientData is the shared classifier 'so a session can't be marked .insufficient on one path and .ok on the other', but acceptance writes hrvDataQuality via SessionAcceptanceService.classifyHRVQuality, a separate implementation with a different no-window rule (session duration vs false) and an extra rule (short <3h session below baseline is .insufficient even with organized recovery). flags.text: Bulk reanalysis (and AppLaunchTasks' temp-asymmetry rescore) call ReanalysisService.reanalyzeSession directly, skipping SessionReanalysisCoordinator's loadPastDayTrainingLoad/warm-cache step. For a past-day session with training integration on, collector.trainingLoad(asOf:) then returns nil, so analyze() runs with trainingLoadAdjustment 0 and no HealthKit VO2max; the ANS readiness (hrvReadiness input to the composite) differs from what single-session Reanalyze produces for the same night. The coordinator's in-flight guard is also bypassed.
